Drop writes no text of a hidden element or a template

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions, HiddenContent

def main() -> None:
    html = '<p>visible</p><div role="tabpanel" hidden>tab two body</div><template><p>row template</p></template>'
    options = ConversionOptions(hidden_content=HiddenContent("Drop"))
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
